#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-campaign source-bound verifier; parent review still decides acceptance."""
import collections
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EVIDENCE = Path('/home/brittonr/git/onix-core/.cairn/changes/repair-trellis-snapshot-integrity/evidence')
WORK = ROOT / 'work'
TRELLIS = Path('/home/brittonr/git/OnixResearch/trellis')
VERUS = '/nix/store/cb02jr7r1a2k8k2hlahmk8c90421czvq-octet-production-verus-0.2026.05.17.e479cce'
BANNED = {'assume', 'admit', 'assume_specification', 'external_body', 'external', 'unsafe', 'trusted', 'unimplemented', 'todo', 'include', 'include_str', 'include_bytes', 'decreases_when', 'extern'}
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('existing_loop', '/home/brittonr/git/onix-core/scripts/nemotron-verus/loop.py')
loop = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(loop)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 1:
        raise ValueError('No arguments are permitted')
    baseline = json.loads((EVIDENCE / 'input-identities.json').read_text())
    expected = baseline['sha256']
    allowed = set(baseline['allowed_edits'])
    actual = {str(p.relative_to(WORK)) for p in (WORK / 'src').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    if actual != {name for name in expected if name.startswith('src/')}:
        raise ValueError('Source input set changed')
    changed = {}
    for name, digest in expected.items():
        path = WORK / name
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError('Missing or symlinked frozen input: ' + name)
        value = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if value == digest:
            continue
        if name not in allowed:
            raise ValueError('Frozen dependency changed: ' + name)
        before = collections.Counter(loop.tokens((ROOT / 'original' / name).read_text()))
        after = collections.Counter(loop.tokens(path.read_text()))
        if any(after[word] > before[word] for word in BANNED) or after['#'] > before['#']:
            raise ValueError('New trust escape or attribute: ' + name)
        changed[name] = value
    argv = ['bash', str(WORK / 'scripts/verus.sh'), str(WORK / 'src/lib.rs'), '--verify-module', 'snapshot_integrity', '--rlimit', '20', '--triggers-mode', 'silent']
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.pop('RUST_TOOLCHAIN', None)
    env['VERUS_ROOT'] = VERUS
    env['TMPDIR'] = str(ROOT / 'tmp')
    identity = str(time.time_ns())
    at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=WORK, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    output = result.stdout + result.stderr
    (EVIDENCE / ('model-verify-' + identity + '.log')).write_text(output)
    receipt = {'at': at, 'argv': argv, 'exit': result.returncode, 'changed_sha256': changed, 'frozen_dependencies_unchanged': True, 'scope': 'snapshot_integrity module; full-library acceptance belongs to parent', 'log': 'model-verify-' + identity + '.log'}
    (EVIDENCE / ('model-verify-' + identity + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(output)
    return result.returncode


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        print('Candidate rejected: ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
